errors.text_span: Секторите изглеждат подредени по низходящ размер, започвайки от жълтия сектор и продължавайки по посока на часовниковата стрелка.
errors.evidence: The sectors are not ordered by descending size clockwise. The order clockwise from yellow is: yellow (57.1%), blue (smallest), orange (medium), gray (26.2%). This is not a strictly descending order.

The description does not mention the approximate percentages for the 'между 10 и 20' (orange) and '20 или повече' (blue) sectors, even though these could be visually estimated. Only the two labeled percentages (57.1% and 26.2%) are mentioned.
